# D-039 restore trace
This synthetic trace is the required restore-after-revocation case. The archived checkpoint contains a downstream director grant and an independent VP grant at policy revision 7. The downstream grant is revoked before restore. Restore creates a replacement identity and resolves current policy at revision 12; it does not activate the archived snapshot. The revoked derived right is absent, the independent current VP right survives, and the archived policy remains readable only through the historical audit reference.
Every decision carries the source checkpoint, source policy revision, effective policy revision, replacement identity map, `restore_decision: current_policy`, and excluded/retained/effective grant ids. This is a documentation fixture with synthetic ids; it is not live deployment evidence.
